project.name: TruckConnect
project.description: A real-time interpersonal communication system for truck drivers enabling geolocation-based discovery, voice messaging, emergency stress signaling, friend requests, and driver profiles with avatars.

UserRegisterSchema.zod: z.object({ name: z.string().min(2), email: z.string().email(), password: z.string().min(8) })

VoiceMessageSchema.zod: z.object({ receiverId: z.string().uuid(), audioUrl: z.string().url(), durationSeconds: z.number().max(60) })
VoiceMessageSchema.note: API route also accepts { tag, audioUrl, durationSeconds } and resolves tag to UUID before validation

TagInputSchema.note: Validates driver tag format e.g. john#1234. Used in user lookup and voice message send.

EnvSchema.zod: z.object({ DATABASE_URL: z.string().url(), NEXTAUTH_SECRET: z.string().min(10), NEXTAUTH_URL: z.string().url(), SOCKET_PORT: z.string() })

authentication.registration: POST /api/auth/register — hashes password with bcrypt, auto-assigns unique tag (name#XXXX)
authentication.socket_auth: GET /api/auth/socket-token — issues raw JWT for socket handshake

user_profile.avatar_upload: POST /api/profile/upload-avatar — multipart, stores file, updates profileImageUrl
user_profile.tag_lookup: GET /api/users/by-tag?tag=name%231234 — resolves tag to user UUID

nearby_drivers.http_source: GET /api/drivers/nearby — enriched with name, profileImageUrl, distanceKm

features: Nearby driver markers (grey dot or avatar circle, orange when selected)
Click marker → Leaflet popup with driver name, distance, Send Voice Message button
Selected driver overlay card (bottom of screen) with Send Voice Message button
Refreshes every 20 seconds via WebSocket + HTTP

voice_messaging.upload: POST /api/upload/audio — multipart upload, returns absolute audioUrl
voice_messaging.send: POST /api/voice-messages — accepts { receiverId, audioUrl, durationSeconds } or { tag, audioUrl, durationSeconds }
voice_messaging.inbox: GET /api/voice-messages — returns received messages with sender info
voice_messaging.real_time_notify: socket event voice_message_received emitted to receiver

stress_signal.description: Emergency alert broadcast to all nearby drivers within 50 km
stress_signal.real_time_notify: socket event stress_signal_alert emitted to nearby drivers

friend_requests.description: Send, accept, reject, and list friend connections between drivers
friend_requests.list: GET /api/friends/list — returns accepted friends and pending incoming requests
real_time_notify: socket event friend_request_received emitted to receiver on send
socket event friend_request_accepted emitted to original sender on accept

real_time_architecture.auth_middleware: JWT decoded via Auth.js decode(), userId injected into socket.data

in_memory_store.note: name and profileImageUrl fetched from DB once per connection and cached

client_events.update_location: LocationUpdateSchema — updates store, recomputes nearby, emits nearby_driver_update
client_events.send_voice_message: VoiceMessageSchema — persists to DB, emits voice_message_received to receiver
client_events.send_stress_signal: StressSignalSchema — persists to DB, emits stress_signal_alert to nearby drivers

server_events.voice_message_received: VoiceMessageAlert — id, senderId, audioUrl, durationSeconds, createdAt
server_events.stress_signal_alert: StressSignalAlert — id, userId, latitude, longitude, createdAt

features: Async JWT fetch before io() connection
Emit queue — buffers emit() calls made during JWT fetch window, flushed once socket is created
onConnect(cb) — fires callback on every connect/reconnect, immediately if already connected

protected: /dashboard — location broadcast, nearby drivers list, real-time alerts
/map — Leaflet interactive map with driver markers and click-to-message
/messages — voice message inbox and send (by UUID or tag#XXXX)
/friends — friend requests, pending list, accepted friends
/profile — view/edit name, upload avatar, view tag
/stress — send emergency signal, view and resolve active signals

users.name: text not null
users.tag: varchar(20) unique not null — auto-assigned e.g. john#1234

security_requirements: All API routes protected by Auth.js session check
All API inputs validated with Zod before processing
All socket events validated with Zod before processing
Socket connections authenticated via JWT (Auth.js socket-token endpoint)
Environment variables validated at startup via EnvSchema
